fusions.name: Clamped Shut
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 20% health. A locking bite that deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Grey Wall Closes
fusions.desc: The pack closes a ring of teeth around you, which deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Sprung for Them
fusions.desc: Sets a set of jaws on the nearest enemy. It waits 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 3 tiles takes 20 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Bites Through Mail
fusions.desc: Your piercing attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour.
